requirement_vague: Item creation should reject description with exact 256 characters.
requirement_precise: Register a new user via POST /api/v1/users/signup with email 'test55@example.com' and password 'validpass123'. Login to get token. Attempt to create item via POST /api/v1/items/ with title 'Valid Title' and description of exactly 256 characters (256 'a' characters). Verify the response status is 422 (validation error).

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/items/ does not reject a description with exactly 256 characters with a 422 validation error.
omissions.reasoning: The item creation request model defines description as Field(..., max_length=255), which only rejects values longer than 255 characters. A description of exactly 256 characters is therefore outside the allowed limit and would be rejected by FastAPI/Pydantic validation with 422, but the requirement specifically says to reject exact 256 characters; the code enforces a broader max-length rule rather than a special-case exact-length rule. Since the requirement is satisfied by the existing validation behavior for this scenario, there is no omission.
